# Failure taxonomy

Every problem a reviewer finds is recorded with one of these codes, so results can be counted and compared. A code belongs to one of the nine checklist items. Codes marked as veto block Verified whatever the points say.

| Code | Item | Veto | What it means | What usually helps |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `WRONG_PRODUCT` | `shape` | yes | A different product from the real one. | Check that the product photo is the main image and shows the product clearly. |
| `SHAPE_OFF` | `shape` | no | Silhouette or construction details differ. | Use a cleaner, straight-on product photo; add a second angle. |
| `LENGTH_DRIFT` | `shape` | no | Hem or length follows the pose reference instead of the product. | Choose a pose reference whose garment has the same length. |
| `COLOR_OFF` | `color` | no | Shade or saturation shifted, same color family. | Name the exact color in the prompt and check the product photo's white balance. |
| `COLOR_FAMILY` | `color` | yes | Wrong color family. | Name the exact color in the prompt and check the product photo's white balance. |
| `MATERIAL_OFF` | `material` | no | Finish or texture differs (glass, metal, lace, print). | Add the material rule for this product's tag to the recipe. |
| `TEXT_GARBLE` | `text` | no | Small print is gibberish or unreadable. | Render at 2K or higher and keep the label facing the camera. |
| `TEXT_WRONG` | `text` | yes | A large word or logo is wrong, missing or invented. | Render at 2K, face the label to the camera, and run a repair pass for the text. |
| `LABEL_OCCLUDED` | `text` | no | Fingers or props cover the printed text. | Choose a pose where the fingers stay off the label. |
| `PART_MISSING` | `parts` | yes | A part of the product is missing. | List every piece in the prompt (for example 'one tube, one cap, one retail card'). |
| `PART_MERGED` | `parts` | yes | Two parts were merged into one. | List every piece in the prompt. |
| `PART_EXTRA` | `parts` | yes | A part that the product does not have was added. | State 'no extra parts' and list the pieces. |
| `POSE` | `pose` | no | Pose or framing differs from the reference. | Use a clearer pose reference or lower the number of references. |
| `IDENTITY` | `identity` | no | The person differs from the reference or the chosen model. | Check the model card or pose reference, and avoid mixing several people. |
| `LEAK_HAND_MANNEQUIN` | `identity` | yes | A hand, mannequin or person from the product photo appears in the result. | Add a 'do not copy hands, mannequins or props from Image 1' rule, or crop the product photo. |
| `ARTIFACT` | `artifacts` | no | Anatomy error, stray text, watermark or melted object. | Regenerate; check that the pose reference has no artifacts of its own. |
| `SEVERE_DEFORMITY` | `artifacts` | yes | A severe deformity of the product or the body. | Regenerate; check that the pose reference has no artifacts of its own. |
| `SCALE_OFF` | `scale` | no | The product looks too big or too small for the body. | Add a size reference or the product's real dimensions to the prompt. |

There are 18 codes, 8 of them veto codes. The list is part of the rubric version: adding, removing or changing the veto status of a code raises `rubric_version`.
